watches.name: Overlord (Owner's Group)
watches.description: We started the Overlord project with a simple question. What if members of the Allied assault forces during World War II designed the field watch they wore into battle? We took that question and asked it to roughly 70 members of the Airborne community. Over the course of 90 weeks from start to finish, we came up with what you see here. The Overlord field watch (The Airborne version requires proof of military jump course completion)

watches.name: KINETIC II Expedition
watches.description: The Kinetic II Expedition shares the Kinetic II platform: a Swiss Ronda quartz GMT movement in a 43.5mm 316L stainless steel case, 13mm thick, water resistant to 300m, with a double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal and a recessed screw-down crown at 8 o'clock. Built for long trips across time zones. Matte or DLC matte finish.

watches.name: Titan
watches.description: The Titan pairs a forged carbon case with a titanium core, rated to 500m and built over two years of testing to cut weight without losing depth rating. It runs the SW300 automatic movement with a 56 hour power reserve, in a 42mm case 11.85mm thick, with a soft-iron magnetic cage, a flat anti-reflective sapphire crystal and a screw-down crown at 8 o'clock. Head weight is 57g.

specsRaw.Strap: Black OTH Strap + ZAS Commando Strap

watches.name: ATLAS III
watches.description: The Atlas III is a 42mm automatic on the La Joux-Perret G100 movement, with a 68 hour power reserve, 200m water resistance and a soft-iron shield against magnetism. The 316L stainless steel case is 13.5mm thick with a recessed screw-down crown at 8 o'clock and a flat sapphire crystal. It ships on a fully articulating three-link bracelet with the SDC clasp. Brushed, matte or DLC matte, black dial.

watches.name: Professional Chronograph
watches.description: The Professional Chronograph runs a Swiss quartz chronograph movement (Ronda 5030 D) in a 43.95mm 316L stainless steel case, 13mm thick and water resistant to 300m. It was developed with pilots and service members who time events across several environments. Double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal, screw-down crown, brushed or DLC brushed, with a Twilight, Midnight or Polar dial.

watches.name: Hydra II
watches.description: The Hydra II is Sangin's take on a mid-century compressor diver, with dual crowns at 2 and 4 o'clock. It runs the La Joux-Perret G100 automatic movement, 68 hour power reserve, 300m water resistance, in a 43mm 316L stainless steel case 13mm thick under a box sapphire crystal. It comes with a three-link bracelet tapering from 20mm to an 18mm Superior Divers Clasp, and a ZAS Admiralty Gray OTAN strap. GMT or divers bezel, brushed or DLC matte, Midnight or Oxford dial.

specsRaw.Strap: Bracelet with On-the-fly adjustment clasp + ZAS Strap

watches.name: Kingmaker
watches.description: The Kingmaker is a 39mm automatic field watch on the La Joux-Perret G100 movement, with a 68 hour power reserve and 200m water resistance. The 316L stainless steel case is 10.5mm thick with a screw-down crown and a box sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating. Brushed finish, black or white dial, with the date window at 3 or 4:30.

specsRaw.Precision Engineering: At the heart of the Kingmaker lies the La Joux-Perret G100 movement, selected for its reliability and precision. Known for its impressive 68-hour power reserve, this movement ensures the watch will continue running long after others would falter.
specsRaw.Anti-Magnetic Protection: A key feature that sets the Kingmaker apart is its iron plate backing, which shields the movement from magnetic interference. This allows the wearer to operate confidently near heavy machinery, electronics, or other sources of magnetic fields without fear of disrupting timekeeping accuracy.
specsRaw.Legibility Redefined: The dial was meticulously designed to offer unparalleled readability. Bold, high-contrast indices and hands are paired with luminescent coatings, ensuring clarity in any lighting condition.
specsRaw.Comfort First: A field watch must feel like an extension of the wearer. The Kingmaker’s slim profile and ergonomic design were perfected to provide all-day comfort, whether worn under a jacket or in rugged outdoor settings.
specsRaw.The Kingmaker: Two years in the making. Built to be with you for a lifetime of missions.

watches.name: Kinetic II Ti
watches.description: The Kinetic II Ti is built in Grade 2 titanium and water resistant to 1000m, the deepest rating in the lineup. It runs the La Joux-Perret G100 automatic movement with a 68 hour power reserve, in a 44mm case 13.6mm thick, with a soft-iron movement shield, a double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal and a screw-down crown at 8 o'clock. Brushed, matte or DLC matte.

specsRaw.Strap: Black OTH Strap + Black Expedition Strap

watches.name: Merlin
watches.description: The Merlin is the most compact watch in the Sangin lineup, a 39mm quartz model that suits both field use and an office. It runs a Swiss ETA quartz movement with roughly five years of battery life, in a 316L stainless steel case 12.2mm thick, water resistant to 300m, under a box sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating. Dive or GMT bezel, brushed or DLC matte, in black, white or Twilight Blue.

watches.name: Admiral
watches.description: The Admiral is a pocket knife made with Toor Knives, pairing Sangin's work on tools with Toor's bladesmithing. Available in Stone or Carbon.

watches.name: KINETIC II Pilot
watches.description: The Kinetic II Pilot was shaped by feedback from more than forty pilots and aircrew who track several time zones at once. It runs a Swiss Ronda quartz GMT movement in a 43.5mm 316L stainless steel case, 13mm thick, water resistant to 300m, with a double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal and a recessed screw-down crown at 8 o'clock. Matte or DLC matte finish.

watches.name: Overlord
watches.description: The Overlord is a 40mm field watch developed with more than 70 members of the Airborne community over 90 weeks. It runs a Swiss Ronda quartz GMT movement in a 316L stainless steel case, 11mm thick and water resistant to 200m, with a double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal and a 6mm screw-down crown. Choose brushed or DLC brushed, with a black or white dial.

specsRaw.The result is the Overlord: a field watch forged in the spirit of American ingenuity and wartime necessity.

watches.name: Professional
watches.description: The Professional is a 43.5mm watch with a Swiss Ronda quartz GMT movement, 300m water resistance and a double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal. The 316L stainless steel case is 12mm thick with a screw-down crown at 3 o'clock. Pick a GMT or divers bezel, a brushed or DLC matte finish, and a Sea Blue, Midnight, Polar or Grey Ghost dial.

specsRaw.It started with a mission: build a watch tough enough for the field but refined enough to wear in the boardroom. The result is the Professional; a timepiece that carries the legacy of the Kinetic II into a new realm of precision, polish, and purpose.

watches.name: Navigator Compass
watches.description: The Navigator Compass mounts on a watch strap, so you carry a compass without adding anything to a pocket. It fits 20mm and 22mm straps and comes in matte, brushed, DLC matte, OD green, camo black and THF Tropic finishes.

watches.name: NEPTUNE
watches.description: The Neptune is a 40mm automatic dive watch built around the SW300 movement, with a 56 hour power reserve and 300m water resistance. The case is 316L stainless steel at 11mm thick, with a double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal and a recessed screw-down crown at 8 o'clock. Choose brushed or DLC brushed, with a black or Oxford White dial.

specsRaw.Strap: Bracelet + Black Nylon ZAS Strap w/ hardware
